Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an elevated error rate (0.18).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — INC-0001 "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy" was created (the initial call timed out, but the incident was recorded; I confirmed it via `list_incidents`).

**Final state:** `checkout-api` is now on **v2.3.0** in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back to 0.002. The incident remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
